description: Rerun unmodified Splash 1.4.0 with all eight Full endpoint-bench tests, including pelican SVG and the current needle no-thinking policy. The base seven-test default-thinking report has 2897.3 prefill tokens/s and 0/10 needle answers; its separate no-thinking follow-up has 10/10 needle recall. Hypothesis: the current evaluator can measure the full endpoint workflow and obtain visible needle answers without a global reasoning override. Preserve the base MLX affine 8-bit checkpoint, DFlash2 draft, INT8 KV, FP32 recurrent state, default automatic verification/memory/context planning, temporary SSD prefix caching, language-only mode and idle release off. Keep default model reasoning except where the evaluator explicitly requests otherwise. Only update the evaluation revision and definition; record all regressions, runtime limits and skipped sizes. No engine speedup or matched comparison with the separate affine-8 .NET engine is claimed.
